summary: Iteration 2: multi-segment network, edit/duplicate, PDF share, installer profile+logo. Backend 38/38 pytest pass (17 new + 21 regression; 1 old regression assertion updated for new segments schema). Frontend (390x844 web preview): calculator multi-segment build (add/remove segment, parent chips, per-segment appliances, total-power, disabled CTA), result segments-table, save with client/address, share-pdf (window.print called, no error), history detail (detail-client, edit w/ banner + 'Aggiorna calcolo' + save-as-new, update persisted, duplicate '(copia)' no banner, detail-pdf, delete), profile save -> 'Profilo salvato' + persisted after reload all PASS. 1 functional bug: editing state survives deletion of the calc being edited. No deprecated Expo packages detected.

minor.issue: _load_logo -> get_object errors (storage down / object missing) are not caught -> raw 500 instead of 404/502 with message. server.py:331-338

422 detail for tree errors is Pydantic's 'Value error, ...' wrapper; frontend never surfaces it (result screen only shows generic 'Errore nel calcolo'), e.g. segment length > 500 m or segment name > 60 chars

ui_bugs.issue: Deleting a calculation that is currently loaded for edit does not clear useDraft.editingId. Calcola tab keeps showing 'Modifica: <name>' banner and result screen shows 'Aggiorna calcolo' -> PUT 404 -> 'Salvataggio non riuscito, riprova.' Reproduced in UI. Fix: in del.onSuccess, if useDraft.getState().editingId === id call setEditingId(null) (or reset()).

integration_issues.issue: expo-print web printAsync ignores the html param and just calls window.print() (node_modules/expo-print/build/ExponentPrint.web.js), so on web the browser prints the current app screen, not the technical report. Native (printToFileAsync + shareAsync) unaffected. Option: on web open a new window with the html and call print there, or use an iframe.

issues: After saving a NEW calc, result.tsx onSuccess sets editingId -> Calcola tab shows 'Modifica: ...' banner for a calc the user did not choose to edit; confirm this is intended UX
No client-side validation for length > 500 m / long names (no maxLength on TextInputs: segment name 60, save name 80, client 100, address 200) -> generic errors only
Default save name sums floats (e.g. 0.1+0.2 -> '0.30000000000000004 m'); round totalLen in result.tsx:27-29
segment-card iconBtn minWidth 32 (trash/remove icons) below 44pt; hitSlop compensates partially

action_items: Clear draft editingId when the calc being edited is deleted (history/[id].tsx del.onSuccess)
Web PDF: render the report html in a new window/iframe before print, since expo-print web ignores html
Catch storage errors in _load_logo and return 404/502 with message
Add maxLength to segment/save TextInputs and a length<=500 check in calculator 'valid'; surface backend 422 detail on result screen
Round total length in default calculation name
critical_code_review_comments: Tree validation correct: duplicate ids, single root, missing parent, detached cycles and self-parent all rejected (verified)
Calculation.from_mongo recomputes result on every read; legacy stored docs auto-migrate via legacy_single validator (good)
Sync requests in object storage wrapped in run_in_threadpool (good); _logo_cache is in-process memory, unbounded but single-logo so OK
Frontend parent candidates = earlier segments only -> UI cannot create cycles; removeSegment reparents children to removed parent (good)

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 1 edit-after-delete bug, web PDF prints app screen)

seed_data_creation: None persisted. TEST_ calculations deleted; profile reset to empty (original state); test logo uploaded then DELETED (has_logo=false).
context_for_next_testing_agent: No auth. Use tap helper: scrollIntoView({block:'center'}) before force-click, since the absolute 'calculate-button' CTA overlays lower content. Override window.print in add_init_script to count PDF calls on web. Image picker not tested (logo tested via API with PIL-generated PNG).
rca_of_issue: Edit-after-delete: loadCalculation(mode='edit') stores editingId in zustand; history detail delete only invalidates queries, so the stale editingId routes save to PUT on a non-existent id (404).
